title: Cut, CutPrefix and CutLast
hints: `before, after, found := strings.Cut(s, "=")` splits once at the first `=`; `found` tells you whether there was one. `CutLast` has the same shape but uses the last match.
In `ParseKeyValue`: if `!found`, `return "", "", fmt.Errorf("missing '=' in %q", s)`. Then `strings.TrimSpace` both parts and check for an empty key.

`StripScheme`: `if rest, ok := strings.CutPrefix(url, "https://"); ok { return rest, true }`, then try `"http://"`, else `return url, false`. `SplitExt` is a single `name, ext, _ := strings.CutLast(filename, ".")` — when there is no dot it already returns `filename, ""`.
